steps.name: install-closed-loop-core
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 24204b287617422057f5a43066606e719570c68b; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage8a/climate_policy.py > tools/ml/climate_policy.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage8a/climate_benchmark.py > tools/ml/climate_benchmark.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage8a/test_climate_benchmark.py > tests/test_climate_benchmark.py; .venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_policy.py tools/ml/climate_benchmark.py tests/test_climate_benchmark.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/climate_policy.py tools/ml/climate_benchmark.py tests/test_climate_benchmark.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-closed-loop-gate
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_climate_benchmark.py tests/test_climate_model_artifact.py tests/test_climate_training.py -q; .venv/bin/ruff check tools/ml/climate_policy.py tools/ml/climate_benchmark.py tests/test_climate_benchmark.py; git diff --check
